retry_rule: infra-only: retry once (max 1) when a call errors with 0 tokens consumed (CLI timeout, process or transport failure); never on a wrong, refused or unparseable answer; same rule for every provider and tier

records.question: How many claims are there per customer region? Show customers with no region recorded as their own group labelled 'Unknown'.
records.sql: SELECT COALESCE(c.region, 'Unknown') AS region, COUNT(cl.claim_id) AS claim_count FROM claims cl JOIN policies p ON cl.policy_id = p.policy_id JOIN customers c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.region, 'Unknown') ORDER BY claim_count DESC

records.question: How many claims are there per customer region? Show customers with no region recorded as their own group labelled 'Unknown'.
records.sql: SELECT COALESCE(c.region, 'Unknown') AS region, COUNT(*) AS claim_count FROM claims cl LEFT JOIN policies p ON p.policy_id = cl.policy_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY claim_count DESC

records.question: How many claims are there per customer region? Show customers with no region recorded as their own group labelled 'Unknown'.
records.sql: SELECT COALESCE(c.region, 'Unknown') AS customer_region, COUNT(*) AS claim_count FROM claims cl JOIN policies p ON cl.policy_id = p.policy_id JOIN customers c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.region, 'Unknown') ORDER BY claim_count DESC
